thread:
sanjay: Spike from prod this morning exposed another UX gap for automatic fallback. When a route flips to fallback we currently (a) send headers, (b) increment a metric. Ops asked for richer context in the header so incident responders know why. Thoughts on minimal info to include?

marie: Minimal = reason + event id + source. Something like `X-RW-Degrade: true`, `X-RW-Degrade-Reason: latency|error|quota`, `X-RW-Degrade-Id: <uuid>`, `X-RW-Source: runtime|router` — keep small to avoid header bloat.

liam: Agree. Also include `X-RW-Fallback-Model` when model fallback used, and `X-RW-Fallback-Pct` when percent-split is active. For SDKs we can add a structured `degrade` field in the SDK response object.

tess: UX side: console should show a compact timeline for each route: state (healthy/degraded), last change, trigger metric snapshot, active policy. Add quick actions: "pause auto-degrade", "force-fallback for 1m", and "start replay". Replays must be rate-limited and RBAC'd.

sanjay: On sampling: we need two sampling axes — "audit samples" (for later replay/forensics) and "telemetry samples" (for dashboards). Default audit sample 0.2% across tenants, telemetry 10% for degraded events. Store audit samples in dedicated encrypted bucket with `degrade_event_id` tag.

marie: Privacy: must support `redact` mode where request/response payloads are replaced with hashes. We should also let customers opt-out of audit storage per-route. Add visible warning in console when audit sampling is enabled.

liam: SDK/API behavior question: if fallback is `stale_cache` should we set `cache-control` TTL in header and include `X-RW-Cache-From: key`? Product prefers returning 200 for compatibility but mark it degraded.

tess: For rollout UX: preview sandbox that simulates a trigger by feeding last N requests through policy logic and showing what % would have fallen back. Useful before enabling.

sanjay: Agree. Small policy snippet I propose (for review):
```
name: auto-fallback-v2
triggers:
  - type: error_rate
    window_s: 60
    threshold_pct: 1.5
  - type: p95_latency
    window_s: 60
    threshold_ms: 800
fallback:
  kind: model
  model: redwood-lite-2
  percent: 20
actions:
  audit_sample_pct: 0.2
  telemetry_sample_pct: 10
  suppress_payloads_by_default: true
hysteresis_windows: 3
```

marie: Nice. Need to define enum for `kind`: `model|cache|synthetic` (synthetic = short canned response). And define what synthetic looks like (templated). Also, `percent` should be able to be a ramp schedule over time.

liam: Telemetry labels to emit: `{route, tenant_id, reason, fallback_kind, model_version, percent_active}` and an event `degrade.lifecycle` containing `degrade_id` + samples links. Make sure these are high-cardinality but sampled.

tess: Console visual: one-line policy summary + small sparkline; clicking opens policy editor modal with toggles and a preview button. Add a "what changed" diff view for policy updates.

sanjay: Operational concerns: our quota/circuit-breaker layer can modify decisions. Order of precedence: operator override > quota circuit > policy triggers. Need to show "effective decision" in UI and header.

marie: Good point. Expose `X-RW-Decision-Source: operator|policy|quota|fallback_router` header. Also show `X-RW-Decision-Effective-Policy` id so auditors can link.

liam: For replays: queue sampled events to per-tenant replay queue, RBAC to start async replay, and store replay result with linked `degrade_id`. Default retention 30 days. Also include a lightweight redaction review step before showing full payload to operators.

tess: Notifications: when a route enters degraded state send a toast in console, open a U-turnable incident ticket in the internal system (low urgency by default), and option to email on escalation.

sanjay: Next steps: I'll sketch the header contract and minimal telemetry proto, @tess can prototype console timeline and preview modal, @liam will spec the replay queue + sample storage, @marie will draft privacy knobs for audit sampling. ops-bot, can you schedule a quick sync tomorrow 9am PT to align?

audit-bot: calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Auto-fallback instruments sync" tomorrow 09:00 PT. Invitees: sanjay, marie, liam, tess.

sanjay: Awesome. I'll drop the RFC link in the meeting invite and include the fake-policy example. Thanks all :thumbsup:
